case.brief: The great tapestry map in the chancellor's tower now shows a river ford that doesn't exist, and a merchant is already charging travellers a toll to use it. Someone changed the kingdom's map.

herrings.garransays: That's his account. Does any evidence contradict it?
herrings.ledger: The ledger lists visitors. Who was in the tower and never wrote themselves in?
herrings.sign: A motive, not proof. Who could actually reach the map?

hints: The map was fine at fifth bell. Who was in the tower after that?
Look closely at the new stitching, and ask who sews like that.

clue.d: Garran mends his own tabard with fine stitches.

people.name: Mira
people.says: Sir Garran mended his own tabard last week. Best stitcher in the barracks, tiny little stitches.

clue.d: No ford on the map at fifth bell.

people.name: Brother Aldo
people.says: When I copied the map at fifth bell, there was no ford on it. My archive copy proves it.

clue.d: Says only Aldo came up, and he never left.

people.name: Sir Garran
people.says: Only Brother Aldo came up all day. I'd know, I never left my post.

clue.d: The ford was stitched in guards' tabard blue.

places.name: Tapestry map
places.text: The new ford is stitched in bright royal blue, the same blue as the guards' tabards. The stitches are tiny and neat: a practised hand.

clue.d: The toll is run by the Garran brothers.

places.name: Arched window
places.text: Far below, a new toll booth by the river. Its sign reads: Garran Brothers' Crossing.

places.name: Seal box
places.text: The Royal Seal is safe in its box. This isn't about the seal.

places.name: Candle wax
places.text: Fresh drips from a tallow candle, the kind the barracks use. The scriptorium only burns green wax.

clue.d: Only Aldo is listed; the guard never logs himself.

places.name: Guard's ledger
places.text: Fifth bell: Brother Aldo, to copy the map for the archive. Nobody else is listed. The guard on duty never writes himself in.

retorts: By the crown, you wrong me, Investigator!
Bring me before the queen, then. You'll see.
case.title: The False Ford
case.wrap: Alone on guard after Brother Aldo left, Sir Garran stitched a false ford onto the kingdom's map with tabard thread, so his brother could charge a toll. Aldo's archive copy and the matching blue thread exposed him.
